name: Lawn Havoc
detailed_description:
Architecture Designer

Follow us and our partners at Next Fest!
Don't forget to add the game to your Steam wishlist!


About the Game

Immerse yourself in the soothing world of Lawn Havoc, a relaxing lawn mowing simulator where precision and tranquility come together. Your goal is simple: transform your yard into a pristine paradise. From the first cut to the final touch, each move you make contributes to a beautifully manicured outdoor space.

Realistic Physics & Grass Growth:
Feel the satisfaction as the grass grows, mower tracks leave their mark, and your efforts bring visible transformation to your lawn. Watch your efforts bloom as each blade of grass is neatly trimmed and shaped to perfection.

Wide Range of Tools:
Equip yourself with a variety of mowers, trimmers, and fertilizers to give your lawn the care it deserves. Whether you’re fine-tuning the edges or tackling overgrown patches, the right tool is at your fingertips for every job.

Seasonal Changes:
Experience the beauty of your lawn all year round. From sunny days to rainy showers, adapt to different seasons and maintain a flawless yard no matter the weather. It’s about keeping your lawn perfect throughout the changing times.

Cozy Home Customization:
Beyond lawn care, enhance your surroundings by decorating your yard and upgrading your home. Add flower beds, pathways, and fences to create your own cozy, outdoor sanctuary.

Multiple Game Modes:
Whether you want to relax and unwind or challenge yourself, Lawn Havoc has something for every mood. Choose free play for a calming experience or dive into challenge modes to test your speed and precision.

Ready to enjoy the satisfaction of a perfect lawn? Start your mower, breathe in the fresh-cut grass, and transform your yard in Lawn Havoc. Create the outdoor retreat of your dreams!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Quad Core Intel i5 or AMD equivalent 4 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
